purpose: Provide reusable infrastructure and patterns for products governed by Intent, Contracts, quality, Evidence and economical evolution.
scope: Reusable product infrastructure and operating-model templates; consumer business state, architecture stages, providers and targets remain outside the kit.
principles: Every change is an explicit delta; unmentioned behavior, contracts, data and configuration are preserved by default
Every interface change reviews the Design System before implementation
Operational risk evolves with measured exposure
Architecture is the minimum sufficient for the current domain maturity and evidence
Complexity has an explicit lifecycle cost, fitness function, rollback and removal condition
Context is compiled from the smallest sufficient authoritative dependency subgraph
Models and providers are replaceable execution dependencies, not sources of authority
Per-run usage is measured and financial cost is reconciled with provider billing
Automation advances only after bounded eval evidence
Consumer targets stay with the consumer
Budgets and alerts are not hard limits
Unknown, stale or unavailable is not passed
